data.one_liner: Multiplatform E2E UI testing framework for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Patrol extends flutter_test and integration_test to allow native UI automation and custom finders. It works on Android, iOS, web, macOS and requires the patrol_cli tool for native setup.
use_when: Need to test native platform interactions (e.g., pressing home, opening notifications).
Require cross‑platform E2E tests for Flutter apps.
Want concise, readable tests with custom finders.
avoid_when: Only widget tests are needed, no native interaction.
strengths: Custom finder system for concise tests
Bundled agent skills for AI‑assisted test writing
weaknesses: Requires additional patrol_cli installation and native setup
Learning curve for native automation APIs
Not suitable for simple widget tests
data.setup_notes: Install patrol_cli, follow native setup docs for each platform (Android, iOS, macOS, web).
